ARM_A.name: Baseline (Dense + BM25)
ARM_A.description: Baseline hybrid retriever without ontology, graph, or temporal modules.

ARM_B.name: Ontology Guidance Only
ARM_B.description: Baseline plus domain ontology query concept and entity matching.

ARM_C.name: Ontology + Raw Graph Expansion
ARM_C.description: Ontology plus 1-hop bounded graph expansion without edge relevance filtering.

ARM_D.name: Ontology + Relevance-Filtered Graph (Prototype B)
ARM_D.description: Ontology plus 1-hop graph expansion pruned by min_edge_relevance=0.50.

ARM_E.name: Ontology + Direct Seed Temporal (Prototype C)
ARM_E.description: Ontology guidance plus temporal claim extraction directly from top seed chunks.

ARM_F.name: Full Architecture (Graph + Temporal)
ARM_F.description: Full IVARA architecture with raw 1-hop graph expansion and graph temporal claims.
